messages:
maya: Heads up 1 - NordicSupply flagged a customs hold on our EU H100 replenishment (6 units, doc mismatch). ETA +21 days.
rik: Which allotments impacted? Any immediately scheduled deployments?
maya: EU-prod-pool (4), DE-onprem (2). Also 8 units queued for additional thermal QA at origin.
nordicsupply-bot: We can split shipment: 6 air-expedites + rest sea. Air premium 22ac2.7k/unit. Need HS-code attestation and PO ref to push provisional AWBs.
aurore: Can we accept vendor-certified refurbers for two critical hosts to avoid customer impact? We'll require firmware parity and a 48h canary.
rik: Ops note: if refurbs go in, annotate AMI + driver bake; schedule canary in staging (2 units) then promote.
procurement: PO PR-8203 is available. We'll sign attestation if vendor confirms provisional AWBs and warranty addendum for refurbs.
nordicsupply-bot: Vendor agrees to provisional AWBs after attestation. Will cover 40% of air premium; Redwood covers any brokerage if misdeclaration found. Creating AWB ticket after docs.
maya: Timeline: attestation + PO by EOD, vendor AWBs in 24h, decision on air-split vs cross-borrow by 12:00 UTC tomorrow.
ops-bot: Action: open incident for capacity-shortfall if any tenant latency > SLO during swap (/incidents/new).
aurore: Reserving 3 US spares as fallback. I'll keep them on hold until decision.
maya: Thanks. I'll track AWB ticket and update when customs status changes. :thumbsup:
